job.job_title: Azure AI Engineer (Azure OpenAI & GenAI) - PAN India
job.job_description:
We are seeking a talented Azure AI Engineer with hands-on expertise in Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Python, Azure Functions, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, deploying, and optimizing Generative AI and Intelligent Document Processing solutions on Microsoft Azure. The role involves building enterprise-grade AI applications, integrating AI services with business platforms, and implementing scalable, secure, and cloud-native AI workflows.




Key Responsibilities

Generative AI Development

Develop AI applications using Azure OpenAI Services.
Build enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions.
Implement prompt engineering and context management techniques.
Develop RAG-based applications using vector search and knowledge retrieval patterns.
Optimize response quality, latency, and model performance.

Azure AI Platform Engineering

Build and deploy AI workloads using:

Azure AI Foundry
Azure OpenAI
Azure AI Document Intelligence
Azure Machine Learning
Develop reusable AI services and frameworks.

Integrate AI models with enterprise applications and business processes.


Intelligent Document Processing

Develop document processing solutions involving:

OCR
Classification
Data Extraction
Validation Workflows
Integrate document intelligence solutions with enterprise platforms.


Azure Cloud Development

Build cloud-native applications using:

Azure Functions
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Storage Accounts
Azure Key Vault
Azure Log Analytics
Azure Application Insights
Develop secure APIs and cloud integrations.


RAG & Knowledge Systems

Build vector-based search and retrieval solutions.

Implement:

Embeddings
Chunking Strategies
Vector Indexing
Semantic Search
Work with Azure Cognitive Search and vector-enabled databases.


Security & Monitoring

Implement:

Entra ID Authentication
RBAC
Key Vault Security
Private Endpoints
Monitor AI workloads using:

App Insights
Azure Monitor
Log Analytics



Required Skills

6-12 years of software engineering experience.

3+ years of hands-on AI/GenAI experience.

Strong Python programming expertise.

Hands-on experience with:

Azure OpenAI
Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Document Intelligence
Experience building:

Generative AI Applications
RAG Solutions
LLM Workflows
Hands-on experience with:

Azure Functions
APIM
Azure Storage
Azure Key Vault
Knowledge of:

Embeddings
Prompt Engineering
Vector Search
LLM Evaluation
Strong REST API development experience.

Azure Machine Learning.
Azure Databricks.
Azure Data Factory.
Azure Synapse Analytics.
Cosmos DB Vector Search.
Redis Enterprise.
Pinecone.
Power Platform.
Multi-Agent AI frameworks.
LLMOps and MLOps.
